title: Clapper on UFO detections at Area 51 in The Age of Disclosure

tellings.quote: James Clapper is on record, you know, in the age of disclosure saying that, you know, we were at Area 51 and we had we were systematically detecting UFOs in that sensitive airspace.

plain: James Clapper, a former head of US intelligence, said on camera that at Area 51, the secret military test site in Nevada, the US was systematically detecting UFOs in that sensitive airspace, Michels says. He cites Clapper's words in The Age of Disclosure, a documentary on government UFO secrecy, during a debate with a skeptic. If true, it would mean a top intelligence official confirmed UFOs were being tracked over one of America's most guarded sites.
